Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.repository.ledger

Interface KfeUserStatementRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<KfeUserStatementEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<KfeUserStatementEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<KfeUserStatementEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<KfeUserStatementEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<KfeUserStatementEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<KfeUserStatementEntity>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<KfeUserStatementEntity,UUID>
@Repository public interface KfeUserStatementRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<KfeUserStatementEntity,UUID>
Reads and removes user-facing transaction statements by owner, transaction, and expiry.

  • Method Details

    • findTop25ByUserIdAndExpiresAtAfterOrderByCreatedAtDesc

      List<KfeUserStatementEntity> findTop25ByUserIdAndExpiresAtAfterOrderByCreatedAtDesc(Long userId, LocalDateTime now)
      Returns the newest active statements for one user, capped at 25 rows.
      Parameters:
      userId - owner whose statements are requested
      now - current UTC time used to exclude expired statements
      Returns:
      up to 25 unexpired statements ordered newest first by their stable creation time

    • existsByUserIdAndTransactionId

      boolean existsByUserIdAndTransactionId(Long userId, UUID transactionId)
      Checks whether a particular user already has a statement for a transaction.
      Parameters:
      userId - statement owner; included because a transaction can be visible to multiple users
      transactionId - transaction summarized by the statement
      Returns:
      true when that owner/transaction pair already exists

    • findByUserIdAndTransactionId

      Optional<KfeUserStatementEntity> findByUserIdAndTransactionId(Long userId, UUID transactionId)
      Finds one statement using its user-scoped transaction identity.
      Parameters:
      userId - statement owner
      transactionId - summarized transaction
      Returns:
      matching statement, or empty when it has not been created

    • existsByTransactionId

      @Deprecated boolean existsByTransactionId(UUID transactionId)
      Deprecated.
      User scope is required because one internal transfer may have statements for multiple users; use existsByUserIdAndTransactionId(Long, UUID) instead.
      Parameters:
      transactionId - transaction identifier shared by any matching statement
      Returns:
      whether any user's statement exists for the transaction

    • findByTransactionId

      @Deprecated Optional<KfeUserStatementEntity> findByTransactionId(UUID transactionId)
      Deprecated.
      This lookup can select the wrong user's view; use findByUserIdAndTransactionId(Long, UUID) instead.
      Parameters:
      transactionId - transaction summarized by any matching statement
      Returns:
      a matching statement for any owner, if present
